tasks.name: 预算
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ====== Story Summary 预算配置 ======
(async () => {
    // ====== 修改这里（只填想改的，注释是旧常量名）======
    const BUDGETS = {
        sharedPoolMax: 30000,        // SHARED_POOL_MAX  共享池
        constraintMax: 6000,         // CONSTRAINT_MAX   约束上限
        arcsMax: 10000,              // ARCS_MAX         弧光上限
        eventBudgetMax: 10000,       // EVENT_BUDGET_MAX 事件预算
        relatedEventMax: 500,        // RELATED_EVENT_MAX 相关事件
        unsummarizedEvidenceMax: 2000, // UNSUMMARIZED_EVIDENCE_MAX 近期未总结证据
        topNStar: 5,                 // TOP_N_STAR       星标条数
    };
    // =====================

    const mod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/generate/prompt.js');
    const b = mod.setPromptBudgets(BUDGETS);
    window.toastr?.success('✅ 预算已保存: 池=' + b.SHARED_POOL_MAX
        + ' 约束=' + b.CONSTRAINT_MAX + ' 弧光=' + b.ARCS_MAX
        + ' 事件=' + b.EVENT_BUDGET_MAX + ' 相关=' + b.RELATED_EVENT_MAX
        + ' 未总结=' + b.UNSUMMARIZED_EVIDENCE_MAX + ' 星标=' + b.TOP_N_STAR);

    // ====== 向量配置：已总结证据预算（direct/distant 共用池）======
    // 与 promptBudgets 相互独立；上限 50000，其中 20% 为 distant 保底
    const VECTOR_BUDGET = 10000;
    const cfgMod = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/data/config.js');
    const vcfg = cfgMod.getVectorConfig();
    vcfg.summarizedEvidenceBudget = VECTOR_BUDGET;
    const saved = cfgMod.saveVectorConfig(vcfg);
    window.toastr?.success('✅ 向量证据预算已保存: ' + saved.summarizedEvidenceBudget);
})();
<</taskjs>>
